offering_wmsLogistica.name: WMS logistics
offering_wmsLogistica.tagline: Run your warehouse with scanners, picking and integrated carriers
offering_wmsLogistica.description: Custom build or monthly SaaS subscription of "WMS logistics". Buy it as software (we hand over the code) or pay monthly while we host it for you.

basico.name: Basic
basico.description: To validate the idea with a limited scope
basico.idealPara: Small teams getting started with shipped orders
incluye: Email support Mon–Fri 8AM–5PM Colombia, 24h business response

profesional.name: Professional
profesional.idealPara: SMBs with steady flow and shipped orders

avanzado.name: Advanced
avanzado.description: Multi-channel with high volume and personalization
avanzado.idealPara: Mid-market companies with high volumes of shipped orders
incluye: Email + WhatsApp + Slack Connect support, 2h business response

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.idealPara: Enterprises with compliance and thousands of shipped orders
incluye: Jira/Zendesk tickets with audit, 1h critical / 4h high / 24h medium

offering_wmsLogistica.costoNote: Carrier APIs (~$50–$6,000 USD/mo) and cold-chain IoT are paid by the customer directly to the provider.
